signals.summary: Remake Shiki's names include Tohno Shiki and Nanaya Shiki as true name.

Remake Shiki is labeled human demon-hunter and psychic, with a Ciel-line Extra End limited half-vampire/Dead Apostle state; activity area is Souya City, and affiliations include the Tohno family plus the Holy Church only for the remake Night Rainbow ending.
The source gives age 17, height 173 cm, weight 57 kg, birthday 1997-10-15, blood type AB, and birthplace Nanaya family.

Remake Shiki is introduced as a member of the Tohno family living in Souya and the Tsukihime protagonist, with Mystic Eyes of Death Perception from a prior event; he wears Mystic Eye Killer glasses to suppress the burden.
His true identity is a descendant of the Nanaya demon-hunter family, found by Tohno Makihisa after the Nanaya family was destroyed by the Tohno family.
